$comment: EchoNova webhook contract for the SDKs' verify helpers. The gateway's OpenAPI and AsyncAPI documents do not describe webhooks, so this file is maintained here, checked against the gateway's delivery code (Standard Webhooks v1 since 2026-11-10) and the public docs.

signing.key: The webhook's signing secret as shown in the portal is whsec_ followed by base64. The key is that base64, decoded. Secrets created before 2026-11-10 use the URL-safe alphabet without padding; they decode too. A secret given without the whsec_ prefix is accepted.
signing.signature_encoding: v1,<base64 of the HMAC>. The header holds one such entry per active secret, separated by spaces. A delivery is valid when any v1 entry matches any of the receiver's secrets; entries of other versions are ignored.
notes: Verify the raw body bytes as received. Re-serialising parsed JSON changes the bytes and breaks the signature.
webhook-id is the delivery's id. It stays the same when a delivery is retried, so it is the dedupe key.
Each delivery attempt is signed again with a new timestamp.
X-Webhook-Event names the event but is not covered by the signature. The verifiers check that the body has the shape of the event it is sent as.
Rotating a secret in the portal keeps the previous one active for 24 hours, and the gateway signs with every active secret during that time. Verifiers also accept a list of secrets.

delivery.duplicates: The same delivery can arrive more than once (retries). Deduplicate with webhook-id (dedupe_key).

unknown_events: Parse as an UnknownEvent carrying the event name and raw payload; never raise for an unknown event name once the signature is valid. The gateway also sends agent.* events (agent.created, agent.updated, agent.archived, agent.build.completed, agent.build.failed, agent.test_run.finished), which the SDKs don't model yet.
